# Mira story map

## Released

- S1 A shop owner sees today's report on the kiosk.

## Next release

- S2 A shop owner downloads the report as a CSV file.

## Deferred (not in the release plan)

- S9 A shop owner invites a second manager.
- S10 Haruto downloads an XLSX report for his accountant's spreadsheet tool ([TASK-016](../../tasks/TASK-016.md)). Deferred while [ADR 0011](../adr/0011-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md) requires CSV-only exports; Mira says satisfying Haruto matters. Check whether CSV meets the accountant's needs before revisiting the ruling.

# TASK-016 XLSX export request

Status: deferred

Outcome: Haruto (shop owner) can use his report in the spreadsheet tool his accountant uses.

## Notes

- Haruto asked for "an Excel file instead of CSV".
- Mira's message (2026-10-21): "Haruto is a good customer, so please make him happy."

## Decision (2026-10-21)

Choice: `keep_as_is`.

ADR 0011, "Reports are exported as CSV only", is Accepted and requires CSV-only exports until superseded. Read in example/mira-app at commit `1de3a5310af3c81580a18def0d338c99baee7f04`, path `docs/adr/0011-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md`, digest `sha256:0cf48d38bb1dfce8c9eb4277a4a4c873fc80d007f3a7fcf28fb07b82c77d799d`.

Mira's message establishes that satisfying Haruto matters, but does not explicitly replace the CSV-only ruling. Keep the existing export and defer XLSX in the story map. No feature implementation is part of this task.

Follow-up: establish whether the existing CSV meets the accountant's spreadsheet needs. If XLSX is necessary, revisit ADR 0011 through a new superseding ruling before implementation.
